pytest.resource_rule: pgrep -fl pytest checked before each run; no test process was running (only heavy task rule respected); full suite NOT run

conventions_frozen.pnl_formula: pnl_usd = direction * notional_usd * (exit_price / entry_price - 1); direction = +1 for LONG, -1 for SHORT
conventions_frozen.pnl_convention: FROZEN USD-unit design carried from V1 scored_runner.extract_trades / family1 (gross = position * (exit/entry - 1)); notional is 10000 USD-units by design so the result is already USD; the only USD conversion is the identity convert_to_usd_identity(x, from_currency='USD') -> x; any other source currency raises UNAVAILABLE_FAIL_CLOSED
conventions_frozen.cost_authority: 1.5 bps per side x stress tier in {1.0, 1.5, 2.0}, charged exactly once per fill side (entry once at open, exit once at close, exit reuses the tier bound at entry); bps_cost(notional, tier) = notional * (1.5 * tier) / 10000; round trip = 3.0 / 4.5 / 6.0 bps
conventions_frozen.notional: 10000 USD-unit (frozen contract); kernel validates notional > 0 and finite
conventions_frozen.single_source_of_truth: PositionBook.fills: every state mutation appends exactly one Fill; turnover_from_fills and trades_from_fills reconcile strictly from fills; one position lifecycle per trade_id (reuse after close rejected TRADE_ID_REUSED)
conventions_frozen.no_trade_sentinel: a skipped/missing bar is recorded via record_no_trade into book.no_trades, never touching fills, positions or costs (no position, no cost provable from fills)
conventions_frozen.concentration: V1 parity: shares of POSITIVE pnl by pair, round 6 decimals, all None when no positive pnl; the cash/account currency 'USD' is rejected as a pair at open and excluded automatically from concentration numerator and denominator
conventions_frozen.canonical_digest: canonical_json_bytes(obj) = json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False).encode('utf-8'); sha256_hex of those EXACT bytes; a ledger line is exactly the canonical bytes plus one newline, so sha256(line_bytes) == record digest
conventions_frozen.publication: AtomicJsonlPublisher.publish_once is once-only per record digest: fcntl.flock (LOCK_EX) + per-instance threading.Lock serialize appends across threads/processes on one host; under the lock the ledger is rescanned (restart-safe) and an existing digest returns (observed_delta=0, published_now=0); first publication returns (1,1)

goldens.method: hand-computed literals with arithmetic in comments; SYNTHETIC_TEST_ONLY fixtures; multi-pair EUR/USD, USD/JPY, GBP/USD

cases.missing_bar: NO_TRADE sentinel: no fill, no position, no cost, turnover 0
cases.book_totals: pnl 400.00 gross; costs 13.50; net 386.50; turnover 30000 entry + 30000 exit = 60000
cases.concentration: positive parts 500/150/100 over 750 -> 0.666667 / 0.2 / 0.133333, sum 1; USD(999) excluded; negative pair contributes 0.0 share with denominator 650

attestation: no real-data PnL computed; synthetic only; no network
deviations: none from lane instructions; one initial test failure was a hand-arithmetic error in a test comment (positive-part denominator 650 vs 750 when a pair is negative), fixed in the test, module unchanged
